title: NTV Android TV v2.0
changelog:
• Major Glassmorphic UI Overhaul: Obsidian backdrop with dynamic ambient genre lighting, frosted top bar with live server halo, category rail with neon indicators, glowing channel cards, and floating showcase hero panel.
• All-In-One OTT EPG Integration: Switched primary EPG source to mitthu786/tvepg (2,200+ channels across JioTV, Tata Play, ZEE5, SonyLIV, Sun NXT with 52,000+ programmes).
• Streamlined Playback Engine: Standardized on stable ExoPlayer / Media3 streaming pipeline with hardware-accelerated decoding and ClearKey DRM support.
• Enhanced Navigation & Stability: Snappy D-pad response, instant category channel preview, and 60fps Compose scrolling.
